brief:
Israeli forces expelled Palestinian olive pickers from their agricultural lands in Yasuf, the Ma'an news agency reported. The expulsion occurred despite prior coordination between Palestinian and Israeli authorities over harvest activities in the area.

Details of the incident and the scope of the expulsion were not immediately clear. Similar confrontations between Israeli military and Palestinian farmers have recurred during olive harvest seasons in occupied territories.
title: Israeli army expels olive pickers from Yasuf lands despite coordination
